item.title: BADDIES: Viral War Destroying Black Girls
item.description: This eye-opening book reveals how social media and reality TV are weaponized to traumatize Black girls. Written by a pediatrician and journalist, it provides crucial insights into viral trends, clout culture, and their impact on young lives. Offering parental guidance and addressing community concerns, BADDIES explores the toxic reality shaping Black girls' experiences.
